Name indexes borrow raw string bytes. Field-use directories and allocation counts are unchanged by token packing.
Class-field contiguity is a census observation, not proof that every legal DEX preserves a proposed range representation.

limitations: ASan/UBSan and concurrent stress were host checks; leak detection was disabled.
Android evidence covers four ABI builds, not device runtime or device performance.
Frozen full ordered/byte and independent fixture oracles precede timed count/checksum checks.
